name: TreeView
label: Tree view
description: Collapsible hierarchy for files, folders, and nested structures.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the full list of expanded branch IDs whenever a branch toggles

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: ID of the initially selected node (uncontrolled)

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Called with the node's ID when a row is selected via click, Enter, or
Space. Intentionally shadows the native `select` event handler, which
has no meaning on a tree widget.
